identity.name: France 24
identity.description: A French publicly funded international news channel and digital outlet broadcasting in French, English, Arabic and Spanish.

ownership.ownershipNotes: France 24 is part of France Médias Monde, which is publicly owned and funded by the French state. It operates under a public-service mandate with statutory editorial safeguards.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Public-service mandate and editorial charter; coverage includes criticism of French policy and a plurality of international voices.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: Generally centrist public-broadcaster framing, with French institutional perspectives and a strong Africa focus.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is explanatory and policy-oriented, without a consistent free-market or state-directed line.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames events through French and EU perspectives and maintains substantial coverage of Francophone Africa.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Established public broadcaster with editorial standards; no MBFC rating parsed in this review, so reliability is assessed from institutional record.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No clean MBFC rating parsed for France 24; assessed as a public-service broadcaster with statutory safeguards.

intelligence.knownPerspective: French public-broadcaster perspective. Emphasises European and Francophone-African affairs, diplomatic process and French views of multilateralism, with a more Global South orientation than UK/US outlets.

selectionRationale: Adds a French/European public-service voice and comparatively strong Francophone Africa coverage.

feeds.feedTitle: France 24 - International breaking news, top stories and headlines

research.researchNotes: Existing production mapping retained. France Médias Monde is the public parent group. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
